home.title: Home
home.intro: Early development build. Product features arrive phase by phase.
home.emptyText: Projects, campaigns and feedback will appear here once they exist. Meanwhile you can look at the building blocks of the interface.

login.title: Log in
login.error: The email address or password is incorrect.
login.unverified: Confirm your email address first. We sent you a link when you signed up.
login.verified: Email address confirmed. You can log in now.
login.resetDone: Your password was changed. Log in with the new password.

account.title: Your account
account.sessionText: You are signed in on this device. Log out when you use a shared computer.
account.profileText: Your public profile shows your username and avatar. You decide which other details appear.
account.securityText: Protect your account with a second factor such as an authenticator app.
account.dataText: Download everything we store about you, or delete your account.

error.notFound: The requested page could not be found.

signup.title: Create an account
signup.intro: Test software, report what you find, and help open-source projects improve.
signup.emailHint: Used to sign in. Never shown publicly.
signup.usernameHint: Your public name on profiles: 3 to 30 characters, lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores.
signup.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A few unrelated words make a strong, memorable password.
signup.age: I am at least 16 years old.
signup.closed: Signing up is not possible right now.
signup.closedText: New accounts are currently not accepted. Please try again later.
signup.checkText: If the address can be used, we sent a confirmation link to it. Open the link to activate your account. It expires after 3 days.
signup.checkHint: No email? Check your spam folder. You can also try signing up again in a few minutes.

verify.title: Confirm your email address
verify.invalidTitle: This link is invalid or has expired
verify.invalidText: Sign up again or log in to request a new link.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.text: Enter the email address of your account. We will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentText: If an account uses this address, we sent a link to it. The link can be used once.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.invalidTitle: This link is invalid or has expired
reset.invalidText: Request a new link to reset your password.

formError.invalid_username: Use 3 to 30 characters: lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores. Start with a letter or digit.
formError.username_blacklisted: This username is reserved. Choose another one.
formError.password_too_short: The password must be at least 12 characters long.
formError.password_too_long: The password is too long (at most 256 characters).
formError.password_too_common: This password is too common. Choose a less predictable one.
formError.password_entirely_numeric: The password cannot consist of digits only.
formError.password_too_similar: The password is too similar to your username or email address.
formError.age_required: You must be at least 16 years old to sign up.
formError.forbidden: Your session has expired. Reload the page and try again.
formError.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
formError.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

profile.nothingPublic: This person has not shared any details yet.

settings.title: Profile settings
settings.intro: Choose what others can see. Everything except your username and avatar stays private until you switch it on.
settings.avatarHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most 2 MB. It is cropped to a square and metadata such as location is removed.
settings.privacyNote: Your username and avatar are public. Each detail below is only shown on your profile when you tick its box.
settings.bioHint: A few sentences about you and what you like to test. At most 500 characters.
settings.linkHint: One https link, for example your website or code hosting profile.
settings.indexable: Allow search engines to list my public profile

problem.forbidden: Your session has expired. Reload the page and try again.
problem.rateLimited: Too many uploads. Try again later.
problem.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

errors.bioTooLong: The bio can have at most 500 characters.
errors.httpsLink: Enter a complete link that starts with https://.
errors.avatarInvalid: Upload a PNG, JPEG or WebP image of at most 2 MB.

mfa.loginIntro: Your account is protected with a second factor.
mfa.codeHint: The 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
mfa.incorrect: This code is not valid. Check the time on your device and try again.
mfa.settingsIntro: Two-factor authentication is optional. It protects your account even if your password becomes known.
mfa.appOnText: Each login asks for a code from your authenticator app after the password.
mfa.step1: Install an authenticator app on your phone, for example an open-source one.
mfa.step2: Scan this QR code with the app.
mfa.step3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
mfa.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
mfa.manualKey: Cannot scan it? Enter this key instead:
mfa.recoveryText: Use a recovery code when you cannot use your authenticator app. Each code works once.
mfa.recoveryStore: Store these codes in a safe place, for example a password manager.

done.activated: Two-factor authentication is on. Your recovery codes are ready.
done.regenerated: New recovery codes were created. The old ones no longer work.

reauth.title: Confirm it's you
reauth.intro: Security settings can only be changed right after you confirm your password.

passkeys.needsJs: Passkeys need JavaScript in your browser.
passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.text: A passkey lets you sign in with your device's fingerprint, face or screen lock instead of a password. It also counts as a second factor.
passkeys.name: Name
passkeys.nameHint: For example the device it is on.

error.unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
error.cancelled: The passkey dialog was closed. Nothing was changed.
error.failed: The passkey could not be used. Try again or use another sign-in method.
error.unverified: Confirm your email address first. We sent you a link when you signed up.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.forbidden: Your session has expired. Reload the page and try again.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

error.denied: This GitHub action is not allowed here.
error.failed: The GitHub sign-in did not work.

github.errorText: Nothing was changed. Try again, or sign in with your email address and password.
github.signupIntro: Your GitHub account is confirmed. Choose a username and confirm your age.
github.emailHint: From your GitHub account. If you use another address, we send it a confirmation link.
github.connectedText: Sign in with a connected GitHub account. A GitHub account is never connected automatically, only from here.
github.notConfigured: Signing in with GitHub is not available right now.

accountSettings.title: Data and account
accountSettings.exportText: A JSON file with everything stored about you: account, email addresses, profile, connected accounts, the kind of two-factor methods (no secrets) and your security log.
accountSettings.deleteText: Your profile disappears at once and you are signed out everywhere. After 14 days your account and personal data are deleted for good. Sign in before then to cancel.
accountSettings.deleteConfirm: I understand that my account will be deleted after 14 days.
accountSettings.noPasswordHint: Signed up with GitHub and have no password?

problem.noPassword: Your account has no password yet. Set one with "Forgot your password?" first.
problem.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again later.
problem.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

goodbye.title: Account deletion
goodbye.scheduled: Your account will be deleted in 14 days.
goodbye.text: You were signed out everywhere and your profile is hidden. We sent you a confirmation by email.
goodbye.changedMind: Changed your mind? Sign in to cancel the deletion.

projects.newIntro: Present your software so testers can find it. You can keep it private until you are ready.
projects.name: Name
projects.slugHint: Used in the address /p/short-name. 3 to 40 characters: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens.
projects.summaryHint: One sentence, shown in lists and link previews.
projects.descriptionHint: Markdown: headings, lists, links and code. No HTML and no images.
projects.repositoryHint: An https link to the source code, if public.
projects.licenseHint: Open source means approved by the Open Source Initiative. Choose "Proprietary" for closed source.

visibilityHints.private: Only you and your maintainers can see it. Use this until you are ready, or for private tests.
visibilityHints.public: Everyone can see it, and search engines may list it.

projects.deleteText: Deletes the project for everyone, including its team memberships. This cannot be undone.

errors.slug_taken: This short name is already taken.
errors.invalid_slug: Use 3 to 40 characters: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens.
errors.reserved_slug: This short name is reserved. Choose another one.

field.name: Enter a name (at most 80 characters).
field.description: The description can have at most 10,000 characters.
field.repository_url: Enter a complete link that starts with https://.
field.license: Choose a licence from the list.

problem.emailUnconfirmed: Confirm your email address before creating projects.
problem.rateLimited: You created many projects today. Try again tomorrow.
problem.confirmDelete: Tick the box to confirm the deletion.
problem.ownerOnly: Only the owner can delete the project.
problem.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
problem.blocked: Moderators blocked this project; it cannot be changed. You can appeal on the project page.

projects.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most 2 MB. It is cropped to a square; metadata is removed.
projects.screenshotHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most 5 MB, up to 8 per project. Large images are scaled down; metadata is removed.
projects.altTextHint: What the screenshot shows, for people who cannot see it. Required, at most 200 characters.

mediaProblem.invalid_image: Upload a PNG, JPEG or WebP image within the size limit.
mediaProblem.too_many_screenshots: A project can have at most 8 screenshots. Remove one first.
mediaProblem.rateLimited: Too many uploads. Try again later.

verification.title: Repository verification
verification.badgeExplained: The team has shown that it controls the linked repository.
verification.intro: Show testers that this project really belongs to its repository. Works for public repositories on GitHub, GitLab.com and Codeberg. Changing the repository link removes the verification.
verification.verifiedByFile: Verified with the check file in the {{host}} repository.
verification.verifiedByGitHub: Verified through GitHub: a team member has maintain or admin rights on the repository.
verification.unsupported: Add a link to a public repository on GitHub, GitLab.com or Codeberg (https://host/owner/repository) and save the project first.
verification.fileStep1: In the root of the default branch of the {{host}} repository, create the file
verification.fileStep3: Commit and push it, then start the check. You can delete the file afterwards.
verification.githubText: Confirm once on GitHub. No access is requested beyond public information; the authorization is revoked right after the check and nothing is stored. Requires maintain or admin rights on the repository.

errors.unsupported_repository: This repository link cannot be verified. Use a public repository on GitHub, GitLab.com or Codeberg.
errors.not_public: The repository was not found or is not public.
errors.file_missing: The check file was not found in the root of the default branch.
errors.code_mismatch: The check file does not contain the expected code.
errors.response_too_large: The check file is too large. It should contain only the code.
errors.repository_moved: The repository has moved. Update the repository link and try again.
errors.repository_changed: The repository link changed during the check. Start again.
errors.host_unavailable: The code host could not be reached. Try again later.
errors.not_github: Confirming with GitHub works only for GitHub repositories.
errors.not_maintainer: Your GitHub account needs maintain or admin rights on this repository.
errors.github_unavailable: Confirming with GitHub is not available at the moment.
errors.github_failed: GitHub did not confirm the authorization. Try again.
errors.invalid_state: The confirmation expired or does not belong to this session. Start again.
errors.cancelled: The confirmation on GitHub was cancelled.
errors.rate_limited: Too many checks for this project. Try again in an hour.
errors.generic: The check failed. Try again later.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.newIntro: A campaign invites testers to try one version of your project. It starts as a draft that only your team can see.
campaigns.slugHint: Used in the address /p/project/c/short-name. 3 to 40 characters: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
campaigns.summaryHint: One sentence for lists (at most 160 characters).
campaigns.markdownHint: Markdown: headings, lists, links and code.
campaigns.timezoneHint: Start and end are in this time zone. The campaign is shown as in progress from the start.
campaigns.targetTestersHint: A hard limit: once this many people take part, the campaign is full.
campaigns.methodologyHint: Notes for testers on how to test, e.g. focus areas or scenarios. Markdown.

visibilityHints.private: Only people your team invites can see the campaign and take part.
visibilityHints.public: Anyone can find and join it. Public campaigns stay drafts until the platform's review and reporting are in place.

campaigns.participationHint: Private campaigns always take invited people only.
campaigns.draftNotice: This campaign is a draft. Only your team can see it.
campaigns.publicLockedNotice: Public campaigns cannot be published yet: they stay drafts until the platform's review and reporting are in place. Private campaigns can be published now.

stateText.draft: Draft: only your team can see it. Publishing makes it available to the people allowed to take part; who can take part cannot be changed afterwards.
stateText.published: Published. It shows as in progress from the start. Complete it when testing is over.
stateText.completed: Completed. The campaign can no longer be changed.
stateText.cancelled: Cancelled. The campaign can no longer be changed.
stateText.in_review: Waiting for the moderators' review. Nobody outside your team can see it yet; you can still edit texts and links.

campaigns.cancelConfirm: I want to cancel “{{title}}”. This cannot be undone.
campaigns.closedNotice: Completed and cancelled campaigns can no longer be edited.
campaigns.deleteText: Deleting a draft removes it for good. Published campaigns are completed or cancelled instead.
campaigns.deleteConfirm: I want to delete the draft “{{title}}”.

problem.public_campaigns_locked: Public campaigns cannot be published yet. Make the campaign private or keep it as a draft.
problem.project_not_public: A public campaign needs a public project.
problem.invalid_transition: This status change is not possible.
problem.locked_after_publish: Visibility, participation and the testing method cannot be changed after publishing.
problem.campaign_closed: Completed and cancelled campaigns can no longer be changed.
problem.below_participants: The number of testers cannot be lower than the number of current participants.
problem.email_unconfirmed: Confirm your email address before creating campaigns.
problem.rateLimited: You created many campaigns today. Try again tomorrow.
problem.confirmDelete: Tick the box to confirm the deletion.
problem.confirmCancel: Tick the box to confirm the cancellation.
problem.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
problem.too_many_links: A campaign can have at most 10 download links. Remove one first.
problem.not_direct: This campaign does not take participants directly.
problem.removed: The team removed you from this campaign.
problem.team_member: You are part of the project team and test as a team member.
problem.not_participant: You do not take part in this campaign.
problem.confirmLeave: Tick the box to confirm that you want to leave.
problem.questions_locked: Questions cannot change after publishing: applicants answer what was published.
problem.too_many_questions: A campaign can have at most 10 questions.
problem.no_applications: Only campaigns that take applications have questions.
problem.invalid_answers: Check your answers: choose from the lists and keep texts short.
problem.rejected: The team did not accept your application for this campaign.
problem.confirmReject: Tick the box to confirm the rejection.
problem.link_suspended: This link is suspended while moderators review reports about it.
problem.blocked: Moderators blocked this content; it cannot be changed. You can appeal on its page.
problem.needs_2fa: Turn on two-factor authentication before submitting a public campaign.
problem.tasks_required: Structured and combined testing need at least one task. Add a task before publishing.
problem.tasks_exist: Remove the tasks before switching to free testing.
problem.too_many_tasks: A campaign can have at most 30 tasks.
problem.last_task: A published campaign keeps at least one task. Add another task before removing this one.
problem.free_method_has_no_tasks: Free testing has no tasks. Choose structured or combined testing first.
problem.task_hidden: This task was removed by the team.
problem.rateLimitedProgress: You saved many statuses in a short time. Try again in a while.

errors.slug_taken: This short name is already used in this project.
errors.invalid_slug: Use 3 to 40 characters: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens.
errors.reserved_slug: This short name is reserved. Choose another one.
errors.ends_before_start: The end must be after the start.
errors.participation_mismatch: Private campaigns take invited people only.
errors.invalid_timezone: Choose a time zone from the list.

field.title: Enter a title (at most 100 characters).
field.version: Enter the software version (at most 50 characters).
field.starts_at: Enter a start date and time.
field.ends_at: Enter an end date and time.
field.description: The description can have at most 10,000 characters.
field.changelog: The changelog can have at most 10,000 characters.

links.title: Downloads
links.intro: Links to the official downloads of this version. Only your team and participants see them, always behind a warning page that shows where they lead. The platform never hosts or checks files.
links.label: Label
links.urlHint: A public https:// address, ideally your repository's releases or your official website.
links.sha256Hint: 64 hexadecimal characters. Testers can compare it with the downloaded file.

errors.label: Enter a label (at most 80 characters).
errors.url: Enter a public https:// link without user name, password, IP address or local name.
errors.sha256: Enter the checksum as 64 hexadecimal characters.

download.title: This link leads to {{host}}
download.subtitle: You are about to leave {{brand}}.
download.notice: {{brand}} does not host or check this file.
download.noticeText: The project team added this link. Check the domain and address below and only run software you trust. If something looks wrong, do not continue.
download.checksumText: After downloading, compute the file's SHA-256 checksum and compare it with this one. If they differ, do not open the file.
download.noChecksum: The team gave no checksum for this file.

testers.title: Testers
testers.intro: Invite people by username to private campaigns. They take part once they accept, as long as places are free.
testers.usernameHint: The person needs an account with a confirmed email address. Invitations expire after 14 days.
testers.publishFirst: Publish the campaign to invite testers.
testers.publicNoInvites: Public campaigns take part directly or after approval; invitations are for private campaigns.

done.rejected: The application was rejected and its answers were deleted.

problem.user_not_found: There is no account with this username, or it cannot be invited yet.
problem.already_team: This person is part of the project team.
problem.already_invited: This person already has an open invitation.
problem.removed: This person was removed from the campaign and cannot be invited again.
problem.too_many_invitations: This campaign has 100 open invitations. Wait for answers or revoke some.
problem.not_published: Only published, running campaigns take invitations.
problem.rateLimited: You sent many invitations today. Try again tomorrow.
problem.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
problem.not_participant: This person no longer takes part.
problem.confirmRemove: Tick the box to confirm the removal.
problem.confirmReject: Tick the box to confirm the rejection.
problem.campaign_full: The campaign is full. Approve once a place is free.
problem.no_open_application: This application is no longer open.

progress.title: Progress
progress.intro: Each tester's status per task. Notes are visible to your team and the tester only.
progress.noTasks: This campaign has no tasks yet.
progress.caption: Status of each tester per task

result.joined: You take part in the campaign now.
result.full: The campaign is full. Your invitation stays open in case a place becomes free.
result.gone: This invitation is no longer valid.

join.title: Take part
join.text: Join this campaign to get the downloads and test the new version.
join.joined: You take part in this campaign now.
join.participatingText: You can leave at any time. Your place becomes free for someone else.

questions.title: Application questions
questions.intro: People who apply answer these questions. Only your team sees the answers. Questions can change only while the campaign is a draft.
questions.locked: The campaign is published, so the questions can no longer change.
questions.none: No questions. Applicants can apply without answering anything.
questions.optionsHint: For single choice only: one choice per line, 2 to 10.

errors.options: Give 2 to 10 different choices of at most 100 characters.

apply.title: Apply
apply.intro: The team chooses its testers. Answer the questions below; you take part once the team approves your application.
apply.privacy: Only the project team sees your answers. They are deleted when your application is rejected or withdrawn, when you leave, and 30 days after the campaign ends.
apply.pending: Your application is waiting for the team's decision.
apply.rejected: The team did not accept your application for this campaign.

campaigns.reviewRejected: The moderators sent this campaign back:
campaigns.publicReviewNotice: Public campaigns are reviewed by moderators before they go live. Submitting needs two-factor authentication. While the platform is not open for public campaigns yet, they stay drafts.
campaigns.methodHint: Fixed once the campaign is published.

methodHints.free: Testers try the software freely and give general feedback. No tasks.
methodHints.structured: Testers work through the tasks you define. Add at least one task before publishing.
methodHints.combined: Tasks you define plus free testing. Add at least one task before publishing.

tasks.title: Test tasks
tasks.intro: Tasks testers work through, in this order. Everyone who can see the campaign sees them; only you and each tester see their progress.
tasks.freeIntro: This campaign uses free testing, so it has no tasks. To add tasks, choose structured or combined testing while the campaign is a draft.
tasks.noneRequired: No tasks yet. Add at least one task before publishing.
tasks.taskTitleHint: A short instruction, e.g. “Import a CSV file”.
tasks.expectedHint: What testers should see when the task works.

done.hidden: The task was hidden: testers had already reported progress on it, so the team keeps what they reported.

errors.title: Enter a task of at most 120 characters.

progress.noteHint: Only the project team and you see this note. At most 1,000 characters.
progress.readOnly: You can no longer change your statuses here.

team.title: Team
team.intro: Owner and maintainers can edit the project. Only the owner invites, removes and hands over.
team.inviteText: The person gets an email and must accept the invitation on their account page. Invitations expire after 14 days.
team.transferText: The chosen maintainer becomes owner and you become a maintainer. Confirm with your password.

problem.user_not_found: No account with this username can be invited.
problem.already_member: This person is already in the team.
problem.too_many_invitations: Too many open invitations. Withdraw some first.
problem.owner_cannot_leave: The owner cannot leave. Hand the project over first.
problem.not_a_maintainer: Choose a maintainer of this project.
problem.no_password: Your account has no password yet. Set one with "Forgot your password?" first.
problem.forbidden: Only the owner can do this.
problem.rateLimited: Too many invitations today. Try again tomorrow.
problem.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.gone: This invitation is no longer valid.

roles.title: Platform roles
roles.intro: Admins manage roles and moderate; moderators handle reports and reviews. A role only counts while the account has two-factor authentication turned on.
roles.usernameHint: The account needs a confirmed email address and two-factor authentication.
roles.passwordHint: Confirm the change with your own password.

problem.user_not_found: There is no active account with this username and a confirmed email address.
problem.target_needs_2fa: This account has to turn on two-factor authentication first.
problem.last_admin: The platform needs at least one admin. Make someone else admin first.
problem.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again later.
problem.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

reports.title: Report

reasons.not_own_software: Someone else's software passed off as own

reports.textHint: What did you notice? At most 1,000 characters.
reports.privacy: Only moderators see your report and your name. The project team does not learn who reported. You can follow the status on your account page.
reports.thanks: Thank you. Moderators will review your report.

problem.already_reported: You already reported this, and your report is still open.
problem.email_unconfirmed: Confirm your email address before reporting.
problem.rateLimited: You sent many reports today. Try again tomorrow.
problem.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.intro: Reports, blocks and appeals. Malware reports and suspended links come first.
moderation.appealLift: Accept appeal and lift the block
moderation.take: Take the case (mark as in review)
moderation.liftSuspension: Lift the suspension (the link is fine)
moderation.messageHint: The team sees this message. Reporters only learn that their report was reviewed.
moderation.blockConfirm: Block this content for everyone outside the team; its links are served to no one.
moderation.dismissConfirm: Close all open reports without action.

problem.message_required: Write a message to the team.
problem.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
problem.not_in_review: This is no longer waiting for review.

team.title: Blocked by the moderators
team.effect: Nobody outside your team can see this, its download links are not served, and it cannot be changed.
team.appealHint: Explain why the block is a mistake. You can appeal once; at most 1,000 characters.
team.sent: Your appeal was sent. The moderators will decide.
team.failed: The appeal could not be sent.

appealState.pending: Your appeal is waiting for the moderators' decision.
appealState.upheld: The moderators reviewed your appeal and kept the block.

moderation.rejectConfirm: Send it back with this reason.
